title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.34777v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench

translated_title: 当每次轨迹采样都失败时：将学习者条件化的选项拼接进长程智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的分组强化学习在长程智能体任务上经常产生全失败组：每条采样轨迹都获得零奖励，使得组相对类方法缺乏基于奖励的策略梯度。一种常见的补救措施是由更强的模型提供完整解答，但完整轨迹代价高昂，且会让学习者暴露于冗长的离策略历史中。我们提出SPLICE，它在线地从失败的当前策略轨迹中构建局部训练目标。对于每个全失败组，一个提议模型在当前策略轨迹中选择一个拼接点，并从该点生成若干有界选项。我们利用重复的当前策略延续来估计每个选项的价值，将正向估计转换为按回报加权的局部目标，并在这些选项上拟合当前策略。我们在两个长程智能体任务（基于SWE-bench的软件工程等）上，跨两个策略家族对SPLICE进行了评估。
tldr: 提出SPLICE方法，在线地从全失败的当前策略轨迹中拼接由学习者条件化的局部选项作为训练目标，解决了长程智能体强化学习中全失败组导致无奖励策略梯度的问题。
en_tdlr: SPLICE tackles the all-fail group problem in long-horizon agent RL by splicing learner-conditioned local options, constructed online from failed current-policy trajectories, as return-weighted local training targets.
